name: finflow
description: FinFlow — SaaS de gestao financeira com projecao de faturas e fluxo de caixa

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build:shared && npm run db:deploy && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @finflow/api && npm run build --workspace @finflow/web
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:reset --workspace @finflow/api && npm run db:seed
